ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var html = result;


var baseUrl = "";
var cm = html.match(/<link\s+rel="canonical"\s+href="([^"]+)"/);
if (cm) baseUrl = cm[1].split('?')[0];


var maxPage = 1;
var re = /[?&]page=(\d+)/g;
var pm;
while ((pm = re.exec(html)) !== null) {
    var n = parseInt(pm[1], 10);
    if (n > maxPage) maxPage = n;
}


var list = [];
for (var i = 1; i <= maxPage; i++) {
    list.push({
        title: "第" + i + "页",
        url: i === 1 ? baseUrl : baseUrl + "?page=" + i
    });
}
 list
</js>
